panel.title: Resume check
panel.allDone: Great — every key section is filled in!

photo.label: Add a photo
photo.tip: A photo makes your resume feel more personal and complete.

contacts.label: Add your email and phone
contacts.tip: Without contact info, an employer has no way to reach you.

experience.label: Add your work experience
experience.tip: Even a small amount of experience (internship, project) beats an empty section.

experienceDescriptions.label: Describe your responsibilities
experienceDescriptions.tip: A short description for each role helps show your actual contribution.

education.label: Add your education
education.tip: List at least one school or program.

skills.label: Add at least 3 skills
skills.tip: A skills list helps you pass automated keyword screening.

languages.label: Add at least one language
languages.tip: Especially important if the role involves working with international colleagues.

aiContent.label: Generate a description with AI
aiContent.tip: An AI-written summary and strengths make your resume noticeably more persuasive.

length.title: Resume length
length.tight: Will likely fit on one page, but it's tight.
length.overflow: This will likely spill onto 2+ pages — try a more compact template or shorten your descriptions.

jobMatch.title: Job description match
jobMatch.missingTitle: Words from the posting not found in your resume:
jobMatch.missingHint: If you actually have this experience or skill, it's worth stating it explicitly.
jobMatch.noMissing: Your resume already covers the key words from this posting.
jobMatch.disclaimer: A simple word-overlap check, not deep AI analysis — a rough guide, not a precise score.

coverLetter.title: Cover letter
coverLetter.subtitle: AI writes a letter based on your resume data — optionally add a target role and company to make it more specific.
coverLetter.noContentHint: No letter generated yet — click "Generate letter".
coverLetter.generateError: Couldn't generate the letter. Please try again.
coverLetter.downloadError: Couldn't generate the PDF. Please try again.
coverLetter.emptyPlaceholder: The letter text will appear here after generation.
